Chapter 496 Aurora God is Dead (Page 1)
Aurora: The god is dead! (Aurora: God is dead! (Page 22) In Astralia, due to the rise of magic technology, the emerging class can compete with the old aristocracy - even the bottom class is more inclined to the emerging class. But the Holy See cannot. There is no room for compromise in such things as faith. It is difficult to say whether the believers at the bottom will buy into the reformists' account. Directly clean up? The entire Holy See may be set back two hundred years, or even directly paralyzed. Peaceful evolution? They have rigid ideas and no chance of negotiation. The Pope is silent, which has been his biggest headache for a hundred years. Servia proposed several plans, such as evading power, economic pressure, and public opinion guidance, but they were all rejected one by one, but they had little effect on the atmosphere in the secret room. Silence fell for a moment, and anxiety spread in the air. At this moment, Saint Aurora, who had been sitting quietly in the corner, drinking tea slowly, suddenly put down the white porcelain tea cup in her hand. "I have a way." Logaris raised his eyebrows: "Oh? Tell me." Aurora raised her soft golden eyes, looked around, and said something in her usual calm and gentle tone. The entire continent went crazy. "We can announce to the entire continent that the God of Holy Light has fallen." As soon as this statement came out, even Sylvia, whose expression remained unchanged, could not help but raise his eyebrows slightly and looked at the old classmate in front of him with a new look. The most unexpected thing was that Pope Gregory VII was not shocked at all. , as if she had already anticipated this treacherous proposal, and had even made some mental preparations in her heart. Soon, Serviya's brain instantly understood the terrible logic. What is the foundation of the traditional church? It is not the intricate connections, nor the wealth accumulated over hundreds of years, but the unshakable faith in the "God of Holy Light". Trying to use conventional means to cleanse or evolve will only make it worse. It will cause a great paralysis in the Holy See. But what if the living water is drained directly from the source? If the highest level of the Holy See declares to the whole continent that "the God of Holy Light is dead", then the foundation of faith that the traditionalists rely on will collapse instantly. Once the object of belief no longer exists, the dogma that the old diehards insist on will become a rootless tree and self-defeating. "It's really amazing..." Sylvia's eyes flashed. With a bit of exploration and admiration, she asked with interest: "How did you come up with it?" Aurora picked up the teapot slowly and refilled herself with a cup of hot tea. "It's nothing." She sighed softly in a tone that was like a spring breeze blowing on her face. "The situation has been too chaotic during this period. In order to find a way to break the situation for the Holy See, I thought about it day and night, and I couldn't sleep at night. Last night, I happened to do something like this. "It's a dream." She raised her head and smiled innocently at the two of them. "Such a trick suddenly came up in the dream. I thought it was very useful, so I proposed it. After all, we have to move forward, right?" Servia and Logaris looked at each other. They suddenly discovered that their old classmate, "Jie Yuhua", who always behaved gently and harmlessly, seemed to have a new level of darkness.
